Definition: a Pelishtite or inhabitant of Pelesheth
BiblicalUsage: Philistine = "immigrants"; 1) an inhabitant of Philistia; descendants of Mizraim who immigrated from Caphtor (Crete?) to the western seacoast of Canaan
